query: SELECT TOP 2048 source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, ref_epoch, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag <= 5.5 AND ra IS NOT NULL AND dec IS NOT NULL AND pmra IS NOT NULL AND pmdec IS NOT NULL AND ref_epoch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC, source_id ASC

derivation.description: The fixed Gaia DR3 gaiadr3.gaia_source TAP query is reduced to the listed source fields, preserves the official magnitude/source_id ordering, derives BP-RP colour, and is validated without sampling or truncation.
